definition: (PROBE, B-NYI-1, scalar remediation C-13/rule-25) NYISO de-leak: CC_REGULAR econ_high 1.21 -> 1.0 (ERCOT-cross-borrowed CC markup, retained only because removing it craters C3a ~ -24% = residual justification). CT_PEAKER 13.15x wall already de-leaked in source (0c6c833 / nyiso-42-band-deleak). C-17 Long_Island 0.45 LEFT unchanged (published Zone-K LCR is a peak-capacity ratio, not the all-hours energy self-supply frac; rule-14 boundary mismatch, issue #1345). Byte-faithful replay of nyiso-41 keeper mechanism set + source de-leak. EXPECTED C3a/price regression, recorded not chased (rule #1); C3a hole = issue #1344.
label: nyiso 47 ccdeleak
market_story: Ablating the only NYISO merchant floor (nyiso_local_selfsupply, the Long Island LMIC floor) lets cheap NYC gas flood the cable-islanded LI pocket: LI in-zone thermal collapses toward the economic import-flooded solution the LP prefers, confirming the floor is what holds the ~8.5 TWh LI self-supply (the residual-identified 0.45 frac, rule-14 boundary-mismatch, issue #1345). Structural floors (firm HQ/Ontario imports, nuclear must-run, CHP steam, coal take-or-pay) are retained. The de-leaked CC econ band (econ_high 1.0) is unchanged between twin and probe, so the C3a hole is not a floor artifact — it is the missing NYISO reserve/scarcity price formation (issue #1344).
